# Synthex UI, llms.txt

> Branch status (`ace/framework-onboarding`): `create --template` and `setup`
> below describe the CLI source in this checkout. Slated for an upcoming
> `@luseefor/synthex-cli` release; not yet in the published
> `npx @luseefor/synthex-cli@latest` build. See `docs/frameworks.md`.

Component sources live under `packages/ui/src/*`. Each component ships
`.web.*` + `.native.*`, plus a shared file (`.shared.ts`/`shared.ts`) where
present; simple components such as `label` and `table` have none.

## Install

```bash
npx @luseefor/synthex-cli@latest create my-app
npx @luseefor/synthex-cli@latest create my-app --template next
npx @luseefor/synthex-cli@latest create my-app --template expo
npx @luseefor/synthex-cli@latest setup --dry-run
npx @luseefor/synthex-cli@latest setup
npx @luseefor/synthex-cli@latest setup --cwd apps/web
npm install synthex-ui # existing app, first manual step printed by setup
npm install -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite # Vite web, second step (Next: tailwindcss @tailwindcss/postcss postcss)
npm install synthex-ui @luseefor/synthex-core @luseefor/synthex-react-web # workbench engine
```

CLI binary is `synthex` (package `@luseefor/synthex-cli`):
`npx @luseefor/synthex-cli@latest list|add|create|migrate|validate`.
`create` takes `--template vite|next|expo` (default `vite`),
`--package-manager npm|pnpm|yarn|bun`, `--cwd`, `--dry-run`; it copies the
starter without installing deps (run `dev` for Vite/Next, `start` for Expo). `setup` takes `--cwd`, `--framework
vite|next|expo` (else detected from `vite`/`next`/`expo` deps),
`--package-manager`, `--dry-run`; it writes `synthex-ui.json` + CSS (web)
+ provider wrapper, prints install + manual wiring steps, and never edits
`vite.config.ts`/`postcss.config.mjs`/`layout.tsx`/`App.tsx` or installs
deps. Dry-run reports `planned`/`skipped-existing` and refuses on changed
conflicts like a real run, without writing. `init` is legacy layout-engine config, not framework onboarding.
Web `installCommands` are two lines: `synthex-ui`, plus Tailwind dev deps
(Vite: `tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite`; Next: `tailwindcss
@tailwindcss/postcss postcss`) in your manager's syntax. Expo second line is
First install `synthex-ui lucide-react-native`; the second install is
SDK-aware and aligns React DOM with Expo's React version: `npx expo install react-native-svg react-dom --npm`
(pnpm: `pnpm exec expo install react-native-svg react-dom --pnpm`; yarn:
`yarn expo install react-native-svg react-dom --yarn`; bun:
`bunx expo install react-native-svg react-dom --bun`).

Tailwind v4 CSS entry written by `setup` (order matters):

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "synthex-ui/styles.css";
@source "../node_modules/synthex-ui/dist";
```

```ts
import "./synthex.css"; // once, at app entry (path setup wrote)
```

Point `@source` at installed `synthex-ui/dist` relative to your CSS file;
workspaces keep a second line for the root install. Next imports the CSS
from the root layout (recommended) and renders the `"use client"`
provider; Expo uses no CSS and its generated provider imports theming from
`synthex-ui/native`.

## Theme

```tsx
import { ThemeProvider } from "synthex-ui/theme";

<ThemeProvider mode="light" accentPreset="blue">
  <YourApp />
</ThemeProvider>;
```

- `mode`: `"light" | "dark"` (default `"light"`). Dark mode also works via
  `data-theme="dark"` ancestor or `prefers-color-scheme` without a provider.
- Programmatic tokens: `createTheme`, `themeToCssVariables`,
  `resolveAccentPreset`; 9 accents (`blue emerald violet amber rose steel
  stone bronze mulberry`; last four have dark overrides).
- RTL: `DirectionProvider` (`synthex-ui/components`, also `direction.web/native`)
  renders `div[dir]` on web / `View style={{ direction }}` on native.
  Uncontrolled by default; `dir` + `onDirChange` make it controlled,
  `toggleDir()` flips `ltr`/`rtl`, `useDirection()` reads context.

## Workbench

`@luseefor/synthex-core` (layout reducer, engine, validation, command
registry, store, serialization) + `@luseefor/synthex-react-web`
(`LayoutRenderer`, `SplitView`, `TabView`, `useSynthex`).
`useSynthex(engine)` returns the current `LayoutNode`.

```tsx
import { createLayoutEngine } from "@luseefor/synthex-core";
import { LayoutRenderer, useSynthex } from "@luseefor/synthex-react-web";

const engine = createLayoutEngine({ id: "editor", type: "panel", panelType: "editor", title: "Editor" });

export function Workbench() {
  const layout = useSynthex(engine);
  return <LayoutRenderer layout={layout} onAction={(action) => { engine.dispatch(action); }} />;
}
```

## CLI (`synthex`, packages/cli)

`init`, `create`, `setup`, `add`, `list`, `migrate`, `validate`, `layout:*`,
`undo`/`redo`, `run`, `history`.

`add` copies both platform sources (`.web.*` + `.native.*`, plus the shared
file where present), excludes test files
(no `.test`/`.spec`/`__tests__`) into `componentsDir` from
`synthex-ui.json` when present (else legacy `components/ui`), resolves
transitive `registryDependencies`, preflights before writing, supports
`--dry-run`/`--overwrite`/`--cwd`. Re-running with identical sources reports
`skipped-existing`; only changed files refuse without `--overwrite`.
Namespaces: `@synthex/<name>`,
`@default/<name>`, `@<name>` (= default) accepted; others rejected.
Remote `https:`/`data:` JSON `{ name, files }` also accepted.
Dependency hints print an install command in your package-manager syntax
(resolved from `--cwd` config/detection) and can include native-only packages;
filter for web-only apps.

## Components (`synthex-ui/components`)

Form: Button, Input, InputOTP, Label, Textarea, Checkbox, RadioGroup,
Switch, Toggle, ToggleGroup, Select, Combobox, Command, NativeSelect,
Slider, Field (+FieldSet/Legend/Label/Error), Form (+FormField/Item/Control),
InputGroup, ButtonGroup, Kbd, Spinner.
Layout: Card, Separator, Resizable, AspectRatio, ScrollArea, Sidebar (+provider/trigger/menu),
Tabs, Accordion, Collapsible, Carousel, Pagination, Breadcrumb, Table, DataTable.
Overlays: Dialog, AlertDialog, Drawer, Sheet, Popover, HoverCard, Tooltip,
DropdownMenu, ContextMenu, Menubar, NavigationMenu, Toast/Toaster/Sonner.
Feedback: Alert, Badge, Avatar, Progress, Skeleton, Empty, Item, Calendar,
DatePicker, Chart (Area/Bar/Line + container/legend/tooltip; web uses recharts).
Providers: ThemeProvider, DirectionProvider (+`useDirection`).
App blocks (`synthex.web`): AssistantChatPanel, CadenceBarChart,
ContactSplitForm, DungeonHUDShell, ExperienceTimeline,
FloatingAssistantLauncher, KPIStatGrid, Marquee, ProjectCaseRow,
ThemeAccentSwitcher, TimelineRow.
Typography: H1, H2, H3, Lead, Muted, Small.

Import from these subpaths. `components`, `blocks` (alias of `dist/synthex/index`; same app blocks as bundled in `components`, no move), `primitives`, `layout`, `hooks`, `icons`,
`theme`, `styles.css`, `web`, `native`, plus per-component `button`-style
subpaths with `react-native` conditions.
Start with these docs. `docs/getting-started.md`, `docs/frameworks.md`, `docs/theming.md`, `docs/styling.md`,
`docs/workbench.md`.
No full web/native API parity or full a11y certification claimed.
